description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log messages within the application. It implements the LogNode interface to receive log data, formats the log messages, and appends them to the view. The class supports chaining to other LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface. Supports chaining and logs messages with different priority levels.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, facilitating thread-safe UI updates. Also forwards the log message to the next node in the chain if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
